queries: WITH per_media AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM per_media) SELECT p.media_type_name, p.average_bytes_per_millisecond, p.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall_average FROM per_media AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.overall_average;

WITH media_averages AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM media_averages) SELECT m.media_type_name, m.average_bytes_per_millisecond, m.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.overall_average;

WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_of_media_type_averages FROM per_media_type) SELECT p.Name AS media_type_name, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - o.avg_of_media_type_averages AS amount_above_overall_average FROM per_media_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond > o.avg_of_media_type_averages;
